title: holdings_snapshot
description: File shape of data/processed/holdings.json. Weights are fractions of the fund and are NEVER rescaled. coverage_fraction == sum(holdings.weight_fraction) (checked within 1e-8); n_holdings == len(holdings); each key equals fund_id. A fund that is absent from `funds` has no holdings file: its coverage is 0 and its whole portfolio weight is unknown exposure, never zero exposure (LEAD_DECISIONS D4). Holdings are a snapshot at holdings_date used for current look-through only, never as historical composition.

holdings_date.description: The 'as of' date printed in the issuer's file.

publication_date.description: When the issuer published the file, if known.

coverage_fraction.description: Sum of the constituent weights held in `holdings`. Not capped at 1 in the schema because issuer rounding can exceed 1 slightly; the engine uses max(0, 1 - coverage_fraction) as the uncovered share.

non_constituent_weight.description: Reported weight of lines that are not look-through constituents (cash, derivatives). Informational; it is part of the uncovered share.

non_constituent_note.description: Optional free-text explanation written by the data pipeline.

sector.description: Sector as reported for this constituent, or null. A null sector is an UNKNOWN classification: for a fund_reported_sector exclusion its weight counts toward the upper bound only.
